name: Pagination
label: Pagination
description: Numbered page navigation with ellipses and a compact readout, or links to the previous and next page of a sequence.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The pager's form. `numbered` (the default) steps through numbered pages
of one list. `adjacent` links to the page before and after this one in
a sequence (a guide's chapters, a set of articles) as two cards naming
them, and takes `previous` and `next` instead of page numbers.

props.name: previous
props.description: The page before this one, for the `adjacent` form. Leave it out on the first page.

props.name: next
props.description: The page after this one, for the `adjacent` form. Leave it out on the last page.

props.name: previousText
props.description: The eyebrow over the previous page's title in the `adjacent` form.

props.name: nextText
props.description: The eyebrow over the next page's title in the `adjacent` form.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: The component that renders the `adjacent` form's links, such as Next.js's `Link`. Defaults to the nearest LinkProvider's, else a plain `<a>`.

props.name: page
props.description:
Current page (1-based), for a controlled pager. Leave it undefined to let
the component keep its own page, seeded from `defaultPage`.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Page shown on first render when the pager is uncontrolled (1-based)

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages. Required for the `numbered` form; the `adjacent` form ignores it.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the page the user requests

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page

props.name: size
props.description: Component size — compact swaps the numbers for a "Page X of Y" readout

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop for the nav landmark.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-page arrow

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-page arrow

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a numbered page button, given its page number

props.name: readoutLabel
props.description: Text of the compact size's readout, given the current page and the page count

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the page numbers is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

PaginationLink.description: A neighbouring page the `adjacent` form links to.
